subject: Gunnery Exercises - LaHave Bank, Southwestern Shore
text:
Gunnery Exercises - LaHave Bank, Southwestern Shore
Military Exercise Area GOLF ONE, GOLF TWO, GOLF THREE, GOLF FOUR will be active for gunnery exercises from 09 Oct 2026 1200 UTC until 10 Oct 2026 2100 UTC. Mariners are required to remain well clear of naval vessels. Ref: NOTMAR F35 - Annual Edition
